actual_scope: Prove a cutoff-independent complete time bound for the native first selected ordinary-bootstrap stage, conditional on explicit uniform primitive and stock contracts. Derive PR1965 H2 from the floor/stopped recurrence, padding, two reversed body calls, three shifts, residual digits and high-part exchange; isolate descriptor preprocessing with an all-width bound instead of an unspecified sufficiently-large-width condition.

bottleneck_link: A cutoff chosen solely for stock fit is justified only if the remaining time bill is uniform whenever the stock fits. An explicit conditional lifting lemma removes the asymptotic-to-uniform inference without adopting the selected all-size producer.

evidence: Written uniform induction, complete wrapper bill and factorial descriptor absorption. Final scientific smoke and registered normal/-O replays: 6156 independent recursion-tree/dynamic-programming and induction cases, 539 complete wrapper bills, 1664 descriptor inequalities, 1458 literal padded endpoints, and 16 mathematical countermodel/semantic/source controls. Selected native stage1 gives K=C*max(401501,2*sigma), with C and sigma explicitly conditional. No new moment-root replay, selected implementation bug, or supplier admission is claimed.

domain: Integer radix-q widths e>=1, fixed q>=2, atom width ceil(e^s), integer borrowed stock 0<=k<e/2, old saving 0<=a<=s<1, nonnegative finite recursive coefficients with both strict moments below one. Selected binding is native stage1 only.
method: Strong induction with separate linear/stopped constants; elementary inequalities with floors and ceilings; exact factorial absorption of polynomial descriptor work per complete q^w fiber. Finite rational specializations and independent recursion-tree enumeration corroborate but do not prove uniformity.
optimistic_complete_bill: For T(n,w)<=A*n+B*n^(1-s)*w^(1-a), the padded two-call body, three shifts, padding scans, residual and high exchange cost at most (4A+6Cshift)n+4B*n^(1-s)*w^(1-a)+Cpad+Crem*w^(1-a)+Chi*k^(1-a). No term is unpaid. K=max(4A+6Cshift+Cpad+Chi,8B,2sigma*Chi,Crem) suffices for H2. This is a proof audit, not a proposed moment improvement.
acceptance: Every coefficient has an explicit premise/source role; K has no cutoff or carried time exponent. The proof handles n=0, k=0, floors, non-divisible padding and completed endpoints. Exact controls reject omitted tolls, absent uniformity, incomplete fibers and lost row restoration.
